_help: Talking manual question list, English (step AM3 first version; the Greek list questions_el.json is the main one). Same format: expect = phrases of MANUAL.txt (any one; [] = not in the manual = 'I can't find that in the manual'), must = the term an answer must mention (AM4), gap = the manual is thin / silent (manual-gaps list). The owner reviews it.
